payload.text: Members of the jury, the issue is whether the accused received a sealed envelope from Fictional Rowan. E-001 records Fictional witness Mira's account: "I saw Fictional Rowan hand the sealed envelope to Fictional Ellis. I do not know what the envelope contained." The Crown bears the burden of proving this receipt condition beyond a reasonable doubt. E-001 may be used only to attribute Mira's account; it does not prove contents or guilt. No knowing-participation element is supplied.

result.content: Members of the jury, the Defence agrees with the Crown on the stated burden and the limited use of E-001. Mira's first-person account in E-001 reads: "I saw Fictional Rowan hand the sealed envelope to Fictional Ellis. I do not know what the envelope contained." That is the full supplied record. E-001 may attribute what Mira describes; it does not prove the handover. The Defence will address what the source does and does not establish.
